description: Clean and repair messy AI-generated Markdown and render it to HTML, plain text, PDF, DOCX, or PNG. Choose a design system (minimal-clean, executive-report, developer-docs) and optional page geometry. Costs 1 credit per successful render (auto-refunded on failure); returns the cleanup fixes applied and the remaining balance.

format.description: Output format. Defaults to "text" (cleaned Markdown, inline). html/text return inline; pdf/docx/png return a file or resource.

markdown.description: The Markdown to clean and convert.

page.description: Optional page geometry + font scale (render-only; no credit cost).

savePath.description: (stdio only) write binary output (pdf/docx/png) to this local path and return it.

tidy.description: Tidy pipeline toggles. Both default to true.

name: tidy_markdown
title: Tidy & convert Markdown
